card.name: Small words after a noun phrase
card.fires_on: Short linking words or verbs that follow a noun phrase and lead into its complement, such as 'of' after 'rate of decrease', 'with' after 'curriculum', 'delivered' after 'information', and 'reported' after 'have been'.

modes.label: Linking word after noun
modes.description: A preposition or pronoun such as of, with or those right after a noun phrase, before the thing it relates to.

modes.label: Verb after information or been
modes.description: A participle such as delivered, reported or occurred that follows a noun or auxiliary and precedes a prepositional phrase.
